candidate.controller: Real system D-Bus service, normal desktop user, actual Polkit authorization

environment.upstream: 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi; Ethernet temporarily disconnected for explicit Wi-Fi-only checks; restored afterward

confirmed_findings.observation: Start returned success with active:true, but the next status was off. Three further starts also acknowledged success and were off after two seconds.
confirmed_findings.root_cause: Not determined; startup acknowledgement is not evidence of a surviving hotspot.

confirmed_findings.observation: Initial Wi-Fi-only tablet HTTPS request to example.com timed out during HTTP. Initial restart/rejoin had a TCP connection failure and the next Start was rejected. In a separate isolated-SSID follow-up, 9 of 10 client HTTPS restart checks passed; cycle 5 had ConnectException with two clients associated.
confirmed_findings.root_cause: Unresolved. No attribution to Relay, Android route settling, upstream transport, or endpoint is asserted.

confirmed_findings.observation: Initial client rejoin did not obtain a hotspot IPv4 address within 60 seconds. A later isolated-SSID attempt did not remain active within the declared 90-second readiness deadline.

coverage.dns: Unique gateway DNS questions compared with direct upstream resolver replies. Matching NOERROR/NODATA is accepted; strict NXDOMAIN probe results are retained in cases.
coverage.https: Both clients, both backends: example.com and www.kernel.org with Android platform trust and HTTPS hostname verification; individual failures retained.
coverage.negative_tls: Both clients, both backends rejected wrong.host.badssl.com at TLS with SSLHandshakeException.
coverage.networkmanager_restart_cycles: 10 isolated-SSID restart/rejoin attempts; 9 HTTPS passes, 1 TCP-connect failure; all profile/interface cleanup checks passed.
coverage.networkmanager_upstream_recovery: 5/5 passed with client HTTPS after reconnection.
coverage.networkmanager_stop_cancellation: 5/5 passed: restoring upstream did not restart sharing.
coverage.create_ap_restart_cycles: Not completed: client rejoin and startup/readiness failures recorded.

firewall_rule_inspection.reason: Renewed OS authentication required for final privileged firewall inspection. No firewall or AppArmor policy was disabled for testing.

coverage.extended_soak: Not run: load was approximately three minutes per backend, not eight hours.
coverage.cross_driver_cross_os_family: Not run: one driver and two Android clients.
